description: This file implements the SimpleBufferPool class, which manages a pool of static buffers for efficient memory allocation and deallocation, including methods for allocating, freeing, and managing buffer metadata.

classes.name: SimpleBufferPool
classes.description: A class that manages a pool of static buffers for efficient memory allocation and deallocation.

methods.name: SimpleBufferPool
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the static buffer pool with predefined buffer segments.

methods.name: ~SimpleBufferPool
methods.description: Destructor that releases the allocated static buffer.

methods.name: allocateImpl
methods.description: Allocates a buffer of the requested size, either from the static pool or dynamically if no suitable static buffer is available.

methods.name: deallocate
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated buffer, returning it to the static pool if it belongs there, or freeing it if dynamically allocated.
